component.name: opentrack
component.summary: Head tracking for game and flight simulators

description.p: opentrack tracks head motion in space and broadcasts position and rotation to flight and racing simulators. It supports a wide variety of input devices including webcams, IR-LED point trackers, Arduino-based hardware, gamepads and IMUs, and speaks the most common output protocols used by simulators (freetrack, TrackIR/NPClient, UDP, joystick, X-Plane plugin and more).
